messages.subject: Mit sizing
messages.text:
Hi.
 I found your mitts online. I think i have small hands. I usually am either a small or medium in mitts or gloves. Your sizing looks like I should be a large. 10 x 20cm. I'm thinking of getting a medium. Do your mittens run small?
 

 Let me know.
 Thank you.
 

 Jennifer Wolfe

messages.subject: Re: Mit sizing
messages.text:
Hi Jennifer, 
 

 We would like to make sure we give you the best advice. Could you send us pictures of your hands next to a ruler or a measuring tape, so we can see your hand measures by ourselves? Sometimes, 1/4 inch can make a real difference! You can have a look at our sizing chart and the pictures attached as well if it helps! (sizing chart and pictures here: https://lasclay.com/en/pages/sizing-chart-guide-tailles).
 

 Please let us know, we'll be happy to help 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
